value.rationale: Exact state complexity of a natural Parikh-matrix entry threshold quantifies a genuine quadratic recognition resource, with a complete quotient and explicit distinguishability witnesses rather than an ad hoc finite census. It gives a sharp all-threshold formula and identifies a diagonal saturation phenomenon useful when designing/counting pattern automata.
